source.origin: Advantage.Bid-led creative produced by the Owner and his creative collaborator after Phase 3P.1 (image-model assisted); Owner-approved by folder placement; the LIGHT recreation the Owner preferred over a dark treatment (the dark version is not in the library)
source.rights: Advantage.Bid-owned reference creative. Calibration evidence only: the composition teaches attributes; the logo drawn inside it is an image-model rendering and is NOT an approved logo asset (production composites brand-assets/logos); merchandise is representative, not lots; every fact and claim visible is reference-only text unless separately approved. TRAINING / CALIBRATION EXAMPLE: 'Lot 7', '19th Century Bronze Horse', 'Estate Auction April 2', 'Over 250 Lots!' are fictional facts and must never enter production factual memory.
source.campaign_title_visible: Notable Lot — Lot 7 — 19th Century Bronze Horse — Estate Auction April 2 — Over 250 Lots!

classification.event_product_type: Notable-lot structure demonstration: one hero item inside one event as a hook to the catalog (fictional facts)

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Logo (with 'THE SMARTER WAY TO BID.' as tagline — not an approved slogan) → 'Notable' (navy serif) / 'Lot' (red serif) + red rule → 'LOT 7' → '19TH CENTURY BRONZE HORSE' → gold ornament → 'ESTATE AUCTION' (red) / 'APRIL 2' → 'OVER 250 LOTS!' → red CTA 'VIEW CATALOG →' → script 'Extraordinary Finds Await.' → navy band (Exceptional Items / Global Buyers / Trusted Bidding) + 'You Can Do This.' Right: a large rearing bronze horse on a marble base, books, vase, flowers, gilt painting; bright interior.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: One hero object at roughly half the canvas, photoreal, on a table with supporting props behind; light background.
visual_read.composition_style: Hero object right, copy column left; light interior; band closes.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Serif 'Notable / Lot' with red; spaced caps for lot facts; red event line; script accent.
visual_read.cta_treatment: Red button 'View Catalog' — leads (conceptually) to the catalog.
visual_read.photographic_style: Image-model rendered bright interior; hero object crisp.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Hero on a table; props behind; window light.

strongest_attributes: The item dominates; the event stays identified; the CTA goes to the catalog — the Notable Lot contract in one image
LIGHT hero treatment — the Owner preferred this over the dark version (a direct correction of the 3P dark-hero trigger)
Lot facts in a clear typographic ladder: lot number → item → event → date → catalogue size → CTA
transferable_lessons: Notable Lot = ONE real item in ONE real event as the hook to the LARGER catalog; the fact ladder (lot, item, event, date, size, CTA) is the structure to learn
Light ground is the default even for a single hero object; dark is now the exception that needs a specific reason (a lit/translucent object) AND Owner review
'Notable Lot' as a label above the item name is an approved device
do_not_generalize: EVERY fact in this image is fictional: Lot 7, 19th century, bronze horse, April 2, 250 lots — never into production memory; production facts come only from the event and lot records
'The Smarter Way to Bid.' — not an approved slogan (the approved buyer slogan is 'The Smarter Way to Shop.')

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Facts are a ladder; the object is the message.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: NOTABLE_LOT profile: label, item, event, date, catalogue size (if true), CTA, band = 7.

composition_assessment.edge_handling: Horse's tail exits the right; whole object otherwise visible.
